_comment: Menu blueprint for AF3. generate_menu.py turns this into AF3 skinvariables files: a home (Discover) widget file, per-slot widget files, a 1104 More Providers submenu with per-provider sub-pages, and a slot manifest. AF3 only renders rows on home + slots 1101-1104 (the 5-slot cap), so Apple TV+ / Disney+ / Prime Video are nested under the 1104 More Providers submenu rather than taking their own home slots. Each widget may carry an ordered params map that becomes its TMDb Helper query, or the leaner info/tmdb_type pair. Provider IDs are TMDb watch-provider IDs, region US. No secrets here; Trakt and debrid are authenticated on-device.
_provider_rows_comment: Rows for every submenu provider sub-page. Latest Series = newest TV on that provider; Latest Movies = newest films on that provider. Kept lean so the nested pages stay light.
_full_provider_rows_comment: Top-level provider slots (Netflix, Max). Trimmed to three rows for the lite profile to cut home-screen load on low-RAM devices.
